content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Warner Bros., Oracle, Micron, Opendoor, Synopsys, Centene, Delta, and More
content.summary: Stocks soared Thursday as investors shrugged off data showing the consumer price index rose for the fourth month in a row in August, reasoning the Federal Reserve is still likely to cut interest rates at next week’s meeting of its policy committee.  Warner Bros. Discovery  surged 29% after The Wall Street Journal reported that  Paramount Skydance  was prepping a takeover bid.  Oracle  was down 6.2%, a day after shares of the database-software company gained 36% to hit a record high of $328.33.
